toegepas.voor: Hy het grond aan die mense gegee waar hulle kon bou en plant.
toegepas.na: Hy het aan die mense grond gegee waarop hulle kon bou en plant.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The relative clause now follows its antecedent 'grond', and 'waarop' is the natural relative for building and planting on land.
toegepas.fout: 'waar' is a loose relative for land, and it sits far from 'grond' behind 'aan die mense gegee'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'waarop' is the more exact relative for building and planting on land, and bringing 'grond' nearer the clause reads more easily, with the same giver, receivers, land and purpose.

laat_vaar.na: Die mense in so 'n familiegroep het mekaar
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: One group cannot help 'each other'; 'mekaar' needs the members as its subject.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A collective noun with 'mekaar' ('die familie help mekaar') is normal, natural Afrikaans, so the proposal only adds words for a Grade 5 reader without fixing a real fault.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'kos verbou' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'kos kweek' is wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'jou eie kos kweek' is natural Afrikaans, and 'verbou' can also mean 'rebuild', which may confuse a Grade 5 reader.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wat ongelukkig was met hulle leier
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wat met hulle leier ongelukkig was
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: In a written relative clause the finite verb goes to the end.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Placing the prepositional phrase after the verb is normal Afrikaans, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Standard written Afrikaans uses 'ophou om te' with an infinitive here.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'opgehou bestaan' is accepted standard Afrikaans; the proposal only adds words.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence speaks of 'hulle lewe' in the past and then switches to 'jy' in the present; matching the person and tense follows the pattern of the parallel line in 'Kos en beeste'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The present-tense 'jy' label echoes the heading and opening and matches the parallel 'wie besluit' line, so the proposal is a lateral move that also loses the link to the learner.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'In' reads more naturally than 'by' for 'among/within' communities here; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'By latere boeregemeenskappe' (among those communities) is natural Afrikaans; 'in' is only a different preposition, so this is a lateral move that also risks a shade of meaning.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: hoe mense aan kos en rykdom gekom het
laat_vaar_vorige.na: hoe mense aan kos en rykdom kom
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Matches the timeless label form of the parallel endings 'by wie jy hoort' and 'wie besluit' in the other blocks.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The past tense matches 'Dit was die ekonomiese deel van hulle lewe' in the same sentence, so switching to the present only changes the tense without fixing a fault.
